name: @projexlight/sdk-device
summary: Device registry + attestation for ProjexCloud field operations: enroll a physical device (phone, tablet, body cam, vehicle terminal), link to a tech persona, run periodic attestation checks (OS integrity, jailbreak status, security patch level), and revoke when device is lost / out-of-policy. Underpins hdk-camera + sdk-evidence chain-of-custody — only attested devices can produce admissible evidence.

endpoints.description: Enroll a new device (phone/tablet/body-cam/vehicle terminal). Returns device_uuid + enrollment token.
Fetch a single device record + its current attestation status.
Run an attestation check; carries platform-signed integrity blob.

events.name: device.enrolled.v1
events.description: New device enrolled + linked to a tech persona.

events.name: device.attestation.passed.v1
events.description: Periodic attestation succeeded; device remains trusted.

events.name: device.attestation.failed.v1
events.description: Attestation failed (jailbroken, patch out-of-date, integrity blob invalid).

events.name: device.attestation.revoked.v1
events.description: Operator (or auto-policy) revoked trust on a device; sdk-evidence + hdk-camera will refuse to register new captures.

events.name: device.person_link.changed.v1
events.description: Device reassigned to a different persona (handoff, transfer, decommission).

models.description: Per-device row: device_uuid, kind, model, os_version, enrolled_at, current_persona_id.
Per-attestation log: timestamp, signal (passed/failed/revoked), platform integrity blob hash, reason.
Per-link history: device_uuid, persona_id, linked_at, unlinked_at.

hooks.name: enrollDevice
hooks.description: Service entry — register a device + bind to a tech persona; returns enrollment token used by the mobile client for subsequent API calls.

hooks.name: runAttestation
hooks.description: Process a platform-signed integrity blob (DeviceCheck / Play Integrity / Windows TPM). Updates status + emits the appropriate event.

hooks.name: revokeTrust
hooks.description: Operator-driven revoke with a reason. Emits .attestation.revoked.v1 which sdk-evidence + hdk-camera react to.

hooks.name: reassignDevice
hooks.description: Reassign device to a different persona (tech transfer, decommission). Audited.

hooks.name: startAttestationCron
hooks.description: Background worker — schedules periodic attestation per device. Safe to leave running in dev.

scenarios.title: Onboarding: enroll a new tech's field tablet
scenarios.when_to_use: First-day setup. Tech installs the mobile app, scans an enrollment QR; sdk-device creates the device row + binds it to the tech's persona.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Device row written + linked. Emits .enrolled.v1. Mobile client stores enrollment_token + uses it on all subsequent API + attestation calls.

scenarios.title: Device passes daily attestation
scenarios.when_to_use: Cron-driven nightly check. Mobile client uploads a fresh platform integrity blob; sdk-device validates against Apple DeviceCheck / Play Integrity + records the pass.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Attestation row written status='passed'. Emits .attestation.passed.v1. Device remains trusted; sdk-evidence + hdk-camera continue accepting captures.

scenarios.title: Jailbroken device fails attestation → auto-revoke
scenarios.when_to_use: Integrity blob indicates jailbreak; attestation fails. Auto-policy emits .attestation.revoked.v1 within DEVICE_REVOKE_GRACE_MIN so a malicious tech can't burst-upload captures.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Emits .attestation.failed.v1 immediately + .attestation.revoked.v1 after grace. Ops paged. hdk-camera + sdk-evidence stop accepting captures from this device_uuid.

scenarios.title: Tech reports lost tablet → operator revokes trust
scenarios.when_to_use: Tech reports the tablet stolen; operator revokes the device immediately so any captures from it are flagged unadmissible.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Device status=revoked; emits .attestation.revoked.v1. hdk-camera + sdk-evidence reject new uploads. Existing captures retained but flagged with the revocation timestamp for adjudication.

scenarios.title: Tech leaves company → reassign tablet to replacement
scenarios.when_to_use: Personnel change. Reassign the device to the new tech's persona; person_link history retains the prior linkage for audit.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Old person_link closed at unlinked_at; new link opened. Emits .person_link.changed.v1. Captures going forward attribute to the new persona; historical captures retain the original persona pin.

compliance_posture.notes: Federal Rules of Evidence 902 self-authentication chain extends through this SDK — captures are admissible only when traceable to an attested device at capture-time. ISO 27001 asset management satisfied by enrollment + reassignment + revoke audit trail. Jailbreak detection + auto-revoke kill the burst-upload attack window.
